rows.text: The Assembly's news item of Tuesday 21 December 2010 (15:05) reports that 'Lord Lasike has become the 17 th Speaker of the Legislative Assembly of Tonga after he was nominated unopposed this afternoon', on the nomination of people's representative Sione Taione, that Lord Lasike is the Noble's representative for 'Eua, and that Lord Tu'iafitu was also nominated unopposed as the Deputy Speaker.
rows.uncertainty: The Assembly's selection (its recommendation), not the royal appointment: the same item says the appointment is still to come (to_lasike_royal_appointment_announced_20101221). Not a holder start.

rows.text: The same item states that 'Lord Lasike will beformally appointed by the King' [sic].
rows.uncertainty: Prospective. The appointment instrument and its day were not found (TO-SPK-05 is unresolved on that point).
